facts.text: Serve the drinks when Doc Holliday sits down at the faro table.
facts.why: Wyatt is shown dealing faro at the saloon, but the sources opened never show Doc sitting down at the faro table. Doc's famous moment at a table is trading Latin with Ringo.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when Doc Holliday tells Johnny Ringo he's his huckleberry.

facts.text: Pour me another, I'm in no rush. Supper can wait till the cards are dealt.
facts.why: Invented. Doc's real line is 'I'm your huckleberry. That's just my game.'
facts.fix: I'm your huckleberry. That's just my game.

fix_note.text: I'm your huckleberry. That's just my game.
